code_review.scope: Integrated contracts, public tests, package metadata, shared checks, and development guides.
concerns: duplicate behavior and sources of truth
public behavior and important failure coverage
resolved_findings: Require a fresh verified process identity before authorizing process termination.
Require render context to agree with result lineage, grid, and report time.
Allow an unknown job state after an interrupted launch from the queue.
code_review.result: No remaining material blockers in the final integration review.

visual_review.result: Visible text and navigation are legible and consistent with delivered P02 scope.
Visible text, code, equation, table, and navigation are legible without overlap or horizontal clipping.
The intended guide content is legible after replacing three rejected blank anchor screenshots. Job transitions, applied-edit semantics, and all five required errors are visible.

limits: Visual review covers the named viewports only. Later sections of the architecture and implementation plan were not visually reviewed.
Long code lines use horizontal scrolling. The edits screenshot does not prove the complete example text; the recorded executable example proves its behavior.
The package contains contract records and Protocol declarations, not external adapter implementations.
The tests and package probe do not launch ResInsight, OPM, Julia, or an MCP server.
